name: 085.2 — one colour, one shape
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 085.2: every colour the API hands back is the keyed table and none of them answers [1], all three write parsers refuse loose components, both table spellings go in and read back keyed, a colour read passes straight into a write, and the draw context takes the table as well as its components. Mints its own map pin for the marker half and removes it again.
